import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    st = np.sqrt(t)
    ph = params[8]*st
    c = np.cos(ph)
    s = np.sin(ph)
    amp_c = params[4] + params[5]*st
    amp_s = params[6] + params[7]*st
    return (params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]/v + params[3]*np.log(x)
            + amp_c*c + amp_s*s + params[9]*(c+s)/v)
